# GhostName

> The open privacy-assurance layer for ENS. Audit any ENS name against the
> stealth-resolution convention, guide a human-signed upgrade, and verify public
> evidence. Read-only for AI agents: no keys, no writes, no autonomous wallet.
> Forward recipient-address privacy for compatible senders, not anonymity.

Keep the ENS name. Break the payment graph.

## For AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to connect the local MCP server, the five read-only tools, the rules.
- [AGENT_DEMO.md](AGENT_DEMO.md): the live demo sequence, audit to handoff to re-audit to proof.
- [AGENT_DISCOVERY.md](AGENT_DISCOVERY.md): ENSIP-26 draft agent records and the preparation script.
- [.claude/skills/ens-privacy-advisor/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/ens-privacy-advisor/SKILL.md): the Claude Agent Skill.
- [server.json](server.json): MCP Registry descriptor.

MCP tools: ghostname_audit_ens_privacy, ghostname_prepare_upgrade,
ghostname_reaudit_ens_privacy, ghostname_verify_payment,
ghostname_verify_sponsored_exit. Chains: 1 and 11155111 only.
